# A replica keeps a box for the epoch it was written in and the next. At each new epoch a member
# rewrites every box of its own that someone has yet to acknowledge, for three epochs after
# writing it, so a reader away for three epochs still reads it. One away for four finds it
# gone, and never reads past it.

create alice g
join bob g
run
invite alice g bob
run
hold bob
send alice g one
run
epoch
run
epoch
run
epoch
run
release bob
run
show bob g
----
— minting a voucher
— give the voucher code to a member of the group (it is also in voucher-g.txt)
— joined the group
alice: one

hold bob
send alice g two
run
epoch
run
epoch
run
epoch
run
epoch
run
release bob
run
send alice g three
run
show bob g
----
— minting a voucher
— give the voucher code to a member of the group (it is also in voucher-g.txt)
— joined the group
alice: one

show alice g
----
— a new group: adding a member's voucher code adds them
— reading the voucher
— added ~bob: they now read everything said in this group
alice ✓: one
alice ✓: two
alice ✓: three

acked alice g
----
none
